question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**was**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate verb for the given blank is '**was**'.
 
• The given passage is in the **past tense.**
 
• Hence, a **past helping verb** should be used.
 
• Here, '**he**' is **a singular subject. **There, '**was**' should be used.

 

**Correct Passage:__** *The train came out of the jungle and passed fields of sugarcane and villages of mud huts. Children **shouted** and waved to the train, though **there** was no one in it except Suraj, the guard and the **engine** driver. Suraj waved back. Usually he **was** in a field, waving; today, he was (5) ______ on a train. *
